description: Look up one Bitcoin transaction by txid - the core settlement check. When to use: has this payment arrived, which block is it in, how many confirmations does it have. Do not use: for a whole block (that is btc_get_block); for an address balance (that is btc_get_address). Returns: txid, blockhash, confirmations, time, size/vsize, vin_count, up to 12 outputs with address and value, value_out_btc.
name: btc_get_transaction
